lines.text: Sanballat ridiculed the Jews before the army of Samaria, and Tobiah the Ammonite said a fox would break their wall.
The wall was joined up to half its height, and Sanballat, Tobiah, and their allies conspired to come and fight.
After Jews nearby warned seven times of attack, Nehemiah stationed armed families behind the lowest sections of the wall.
Nehemiah told the people to remember the Lord, and each builder worked with a sword at his side.
Nehemiah told every man to spend the night inside Jericho to guard by night and work by day.
